tools.name: toolaby_docs
tools.description: Toolaby's docs as Markdown. Without a page: the index, every page with what it covers. With a page (like "gating", "pricing", "reference/client"): that page.

tools.name: toolaby_search_docs
tools.description: Searches Toolaby's docs: the pages and passages that match, each page with its name and its Markdown address.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "toolaby_search_docs" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search Toolaby's docs. Call it before writing Toolaby code: it answers the pages and passages that match, each page with its Markdown address and the name toolaby_docs reads it by." → after: "Searches Toolaby's docs: the pages and passages that match, each page with its name and its Markdown address."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
